judged_text: The dialog's error state (`isInvalidEmail`) and entered emails are only reset on the Cancel button and onSuccess, not when the dialog is dismissed via overlay/Escape; onSuccess resets emails but not `isInvalidEmail`. A user who triggers the validation error, closes the dialog via Escape, and reopens it later is greeted with their stale input plus a stale 'Emails must be unique and valid' warning even in a fresh, empty state — the error banner outlives the input that caused it.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, component state is only reset on Cancel (`setMultiEmailValue([""]); setIsInvalidEmail(false); setIsOpenDialog(false);`) and partially on mutation success (`setIsOpenDialog(false); setMultiEmailValue([""]);`), but `isInvalidEmail` is not cleared on success. Also, the dialog can be dismissed via `Dialog` overlay/Escape because `Dialog open={isOpenDialog} onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` directly closes it without any cleanup; no effect/watch resets `multiEmailValue`/`isInvalidEmail` when `isOpenDialog` becomes false. This means validation errors and/or entered emails can persist when reopening, and the error banner can remain visible even after success resets the input to `[""]`.
